about.title: About
about.whatIsThisDesc: {title} is a free, interactive web map for the Croatian Long Distance Trail (CLDT). Use it to explore the route, check elevation profiles, measure distances, and share your position with others. It works on desktop and mobile browsers.
about.aboutCldtDesc: The Croatian Long Distance Trail is a national long-distance hiking trail spanning over 2,200 km across Croatia, from Ilok in the east to Prevlaka in the south. It passes through mountains, coastal regions, and cultural landmarks. The trail is maintained by the <link>{associationLink}</link>.

mapFeaturesList.trail: Click the route or elevation chart to see distance and elevation at any point
mapFeaturesList.elevation: Elevation profile chart; hover to preview on the map, click to pin a point
mapFeaturesList.ruler: Distance ruler to measure segments between two points
mapFeaturesList.layers: Multiple map layers (standard, topo, satellite, terrain, cycling, Croatia Topo)
mapFeaturesList.location: Optional location tracking to see your position on the trail
mapFeaturesList.share: Share links with your current view or progress on the trail
mapFeaturesList.darkMode: Dark mode and battery saver options
mapFeaturesList.offlineMaps: Offline maps - pre-cache the trail corridor for use without a signal
mapFeaturesList.gpxExport: GPX export - download the full trail or a ruler-selected segment as a .gpx file for GPS devices
mapFeaturesList.printExport: Print and export - save the current map view as a PDF or PNG image
mapFeaturesList.weather: Current weather at your trail location - temperature, wind, precipitation probability, sunrise/sunset; 12-hour hourly forecast with precipitation bars and best-window hint (DHMZ + Open-Meteo)
mapFeaturesList.trailNotices: Regional trail condition notices - dismissible banners with alerts for current conditions on the trail
mapFeaturesList.seasonalStatus: Seasonal trail status - curated map layer of warnings, closures, and seasonal conditions sourced from DHMZ, HGSS, HPS, and Croatian national parks; severity-colored chip markers along the trail at the centre of each affected range; hover or click a chip to highlight the affected stretch and open a detail popout with severity, recommended gear, and a link to the original notice; data refreshed by running `npm run update-seasonal`
mapFeaturesList.radar: Precipitation radar overlay - animated RainViewer radar with past and nowcast frames, play/pause controls, and colour legend
mapFeaturesList.sunsetPosition: Sunset/sunrise position - projects where you will be on the trail at sunset and sunrise based on your current pace; toggleable markers on the polyline
mapFeaturesList.stagePlanner: Multi-day stage planner - split any trail range into daily stages by distance or time, view per-stage elevation and ETA stats, export individual stages as GPX files, or export all stages as a strip-map PDF
mapFeaturesList.gpxImport: GPX track import - drag and drop (or pick) a recorded GPX file to overlay your actual hike on the map; compare your track against the official trail with stats on distance, pace, elapsed time, max deviation, and % of trail covered
mapFeaturesList.emergency: Emergency 112 panel - long-press the red SOS button (bottom-right) for an offline-first panel showing your GPS coordinates, Plus Code, trail section and km, and the bearing and distance to the nearest road access and HGSS mountain rescue station; copy any field to the clipboard and hand off to your phone dialer (Call 112) or maps app (Open in maps); fully offline once cached
mapFeaturesList.trailStyle: Trail style - choose how the route polyline is coloured from the layers panel: Default (single colour), Sections (A/B/C zones with boundary markers and per-section stats), Grade (Strava-style gradient tinting with five bands; warm for ascents and cool for descents in the active travel direction; colour-ramp legend in the panel; recomputed when the SOBO/NOBO direction is toggled), Surface, or Difficulty (SAC)
mapFeaturesList.surfaceAndSac: Surface and difficulty colouring - tint the trail polyline (and the elevation chart's area fill) by OSM surface type (paved / unpaved / gravel / ground / rock) or by SAC hiking scale (T1 hiking through T6 difficult alpine hiking). The data is enriched monthly from OpenStreetMap by a GitHub Action; surface and SAC options stay disabled until the dataset finishes loading on first paint. Direction-aware: the dataset is keyed to SOBO km and the renderer mirrors to NOBO on the fly
mapFeaturesList.distanceMarkers: Distance markers - small km / mi labels along the trail at 100 / 50 / 25 / 10 / 5 / 1 unit intervals. Progressive disclosure by zoom level: 100 km always visible at any zoom, finer intervals reveal as you zoom in (1 km labels only at zoom 13+). Toggleable from Settings; labels follow the active unit system and current direction (SOBO/NOBO)
mapFeaturesList.pois: Points of interest, list and search - around 7,700 places along the trail (towns, settlements, peaks, viewpoints, mountain huts, shelters, food, and ATMs) inside the Croatian border. Per-type and per-tag filters from Settings and the list panel. Markers cluster at country zoom and split out as you zoom in. Popups carry a multi-image photo gallery (Wikimedia Commons, with per-image attribution and licence; tap any thumbnail for a fullscreen lightbox with keyboard navigation), a Wikipedia summary that appears immediately (baked at enrichment time for the popular places, lazy-fetched for the rest), a provenance footer that tells you where the data came from and when it was last verified, and a Copy link button that deep-links straight to the place. The list panel sorts by trail km, name, off-trail distance, or Near me when GPS is locked; an optional 50 km decade grouping turns the long list into chapters with sticky headers; full keyboard navigation. The multi-day stage planner shows how many places fall inside each daily stage, lists them in walking order, and can export every POI across the whole plan as a single GPX waypoint file. Imported GPX tracks can list the POIs you passed within 500 m, sorted in walking order. Search by name (diacritic-folded) or by km to jump to a point. Pre-cached corridor downloads also pull POI thumbnails and Wikipedia summaries so popups stay rich offline. Dataset is refreshed monthly from OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons, and the HPS hut directory; the enricher is failure-resilient so a single bad day at one upstream service can never silently degrade the dataset
mapFeaturesList.tripBrief: Trip brief export - one-click printable brief (PDF for print, DOCX for editing) generated from your multi-day stage plan. Each day gets its own page with a map snapshot, a templated narrative, places along the way (name, type, trail km, photos, Wikipedia summary), and any seasonal-status alerts that intersect the day's range. The back page bundles emergency guidance: 112 dial, HGSS request format, and field essentials. Localised to en / hr / de / it. AI-generated narratives are reserved for a future release; the current export ships with deterministic templated text that still reads naturally

about.dataAttributionDesc: Trail data is provided by the Udruga Long Distance Trail Hrvatska (LDTH) organization. Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, CyclOSM, and other providers. Croatian topographic maps are from the State Geodetic Administration (DGU). Weather data comes from DHMZ (Croatian Met Service) and Open-Meteo. Radar tiles are provided by RainViewer. Seasonal trail status, hazard warnings, and mountain rescue station data are sourced from HGSS (Croatian Mountain Rescue Service), HPS (Croatian Mountaineering Federation), and the national park authorities (NP Plitvička jezera, NP Sjeverni Velebit, NP Paklenica, NP Krka) together with Park prirode Velebit. Data displayed on this site may not reflect the latest conditions. When in doubt, always verify with the official sources.
about.privacyDesc: Your location is used only when you enable it and grant permission. It is never sent to any server - everything runs in your browser. No account or login is required.

mapControls.batterySaverTooltip: Reduces location update frequency and animations to save battery.
mapControls.compassHeadingTooltip: Shows which way you are facing as a cone on your location marker. Uses the device compass; on iPhone you will be asked for permission.
mapControls.keepScreenOnTooltip: Prevents the display from sleeping while your GPS position is shown on the map. Battery saver mode overrides this. Not supported in every browser.
mapControls.offRouteAlertTooltip: Warns with a banner and vibration when you drift more than ~200 m off the trail. Arms itself only after you have actually been on the trail, so it stays silent at home, in town, or while driving - and switches off by itself when you leave the trail area.

mapControls.showSectionsTooltip: Color-codes the trail by section and shows section boundary markers with stats.
mapControls.showDistanceMarkersTooltip: Show distance milestones along the trail (100, 50, 25, 10, 5, 1). More markers appear as you zoom in.

storeTest.offRouteDescription: Drives the real alert banner by injecting synthetic GPS fixes (user location + closest trail point) into the stores. Enable the feature, send 3 on-trail fixes to arm the machine, then 3 off-trail fixes to raise the alert. A far fix exercises auto-disarm; an inaccurate fix should change nothing.
storeTest.offRouteEnableFirst: Enable the off-route alert to start simulating.
storeTest.offRouteBannerEmpty: The alert banner renders here while alerting.
storeTest.offRouteSnoozedHint: No banner while the phase is alerting means it was dismissed; it stays snoozed until the alert resolves and a new drift occurs.
storeTest.title: Store Persistence Test
storeTest.instruction1: Toggle some settings (direction, units, boundary, etc.)
storeTest.instruction2: Refresh the page and check if the settings persist
storeTest.instruction3: Close the browser tab and reopen to verify persistence between sessions
storeTest.instructionNote: In the real application, these settings initialize the map controls when loading the page.

gpxDownload.disclaimerIntro: Welcome to the Croatian Long Distance Trail GPX download section! Here you can download the GPS track and explore it on the interactive map. Please note the following:
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem1: The trail is currently under construction.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem2: The main navigation tool is still the FarOut mobile app.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem3: The public GPX file does not contain waypoints, which are essential for trail navigation. These are available within the FarOut mobile app.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem4: The only official GPX file is available on our website.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem5: We cannot guarantee the accuracy of tracks downloaded from other sources.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem6: Our website will always have the most up-to-date version of the track.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem7: Use of the track is at your own risk.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem8: The Udruga Long Distance Trail Hrvatska disclaims any liability in the event of accidents while using the GPX record and visiting the trail.
gpxDownload.disclaimerItem9: Resale and use of the CLDT GPX file for financial gain is a criminal offence and is subject to prosecution.
gpxDownload.acknowledgmentLabel: I am aware of the possible dangers on the trail and will explore and use it responsibly, respecting the Leave No Trace principles.
